name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted IP toolbox: IP and geolocation lookup, WebRTC and DNS leak tests, speed test, MTR, Whois and connectivity checks.

alerts.message: IP geolocation and ASN lookups need free MaxMind GeoLite2 credentials. Set MAXMIND_ACCOUNT_ID and MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY in the environment and redeploy; without them the MaxMind source returns errors.
